aiSummary: What are the check-in and check-out times at Moganshan Jiuqu Bay Inn?
address: No.43 Middle Village, Ziling Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China
priceRange: Unbeatable daily deals - quickly find great rates for your ideal stay. And if it's cheaper elsewhere, we'll refund the difference.

comments.quote: 房間很乾凈了，比想象的乾淨很多，app上展示的照片太昏暗了，其實挺亮堂的。床也挺舒服的，停車還算方便，門口就是停車位。性價比很高
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: The room was very clean, a good deal cleaner than I had pictured. The photographs in the app are far too dark and it is actually quite bright. The bed is comfortable and parking is easy, right at the door. Very good value.

comments.quote: 屋後竹林，窗外竹林、小菜園，很清凈。 庭前石徑小路很乾凈， 早餐豐富，老闆話不多，面善，很實在。 一同入住的還有其他幾房旅客，也不吵鬧，感覺不錯。 總體環境清幽。
comments.author: Guest User

comments.quote: 空間很足，設施齊全，乾淨衞生，周邊很安靜，晚上睡得很舒服，老闆很好客，附近小店餐廳齊全，購物很方便。
comments.author: Guest User
